name: plain
description: Plain: for a project whose output is documents. One long-lived branch, main, holds the documents under artifacts/; each task is a branch agent/<slug> cut from main, checked by a command set with the task, reviewed, and merged back with --no-ff. There are no feature, release or hotfix branches, no tags, no version file and no changelog: nothing is released, and the feature, release and hotfix verbs refuse.

tests.task: the check set with the task, run on the document: it exists, its format parses, its required headings and links are there

work: a task is a branch agent/<slug> cut from main, for one document or one set of related edits
the check that says the task is done is set with the task and is mechanical: the file exists, its format parses, its length, headings and links are right
someone other than the writer reads the change before it is merged; a change outside the paths the task named is refused
the reviewed branch is merged into main with --no-ff; main holds the documents as they stand

deployment.note: Where the documents go once they are done differs a lot between projects, so nothing is set up unless you choose it. Each option can be done by hand.

options.title: Nothing yet
options.instructions: The documents under artifacts/ on main are the output. Decide how they reach their readers later.

options.title: A static site built from artifacts/
options.instructions: Pick a static site generator that reads Markdown, point it at artifacts/, and have a workflow build and publish the site when main changes. Keep any publishing credential as a repository secret, never in the repository.
